audit_findings_summary.p0_a_snapshot_consistency: Sequential raw copy lacks multi-store transactional atomicity. Quiescent window and cross-store chunk validation required.
audit_findings_summary.p0_b_model_provenance: llama-server PID 2404 started 2026-11-17 23:05:33 via Gemini agent background task per operator chat instruction (step 8). Transparently documented.
audit_findings_summary.p0_c_model_identity: LanceDB index_manifest.json specifies Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-GGUF, dim 1024, parent-child-tiktoken-v1. Formal status remains UNVERIFIED until bitwise vector equality verified.
audit_findings_summary.p1_d_primary_sources: Q004 is 'Общие приемные устройства' (not duct limits); Q010 is truncated; Q088 is SYNTHETIC_ADVERSARIAL with 2012 vs 2020 ambiguity. Gold answers marked UNVERIFIED pending certified citations.
audit_findings_summary.p1_e_shadow_eig_invariance: Invariant maintained: 100% identical rank and payload between OFF and ON. EIG is passive telemetry, not retrieval filter.
audit_findings_summary.p1_f_boot_recovery_status: LogonTrigger + 5m poll configured in Task Scheduler, but unobserved after physical reboot. Status: CONFIGURED_UNOBSERVED.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Snapshot method atomicity and mutation race condition
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: Sequential raw copy is non-atomic. PRAGMA integrity_check only validates SQLite internals. Formal snapshot method requires quiescent window and post-copy cross-store checks.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Cross-store orphan and quarantine chunk consistency
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: SQLite chunk_cache has 1,569,491 records vs LanceDB 1,341,830 rows (delta: 227,661 historical/quarantine chunks). Preflight cross-store validation required before search.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Isolated task config strictly decoupled from production
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: isolated_config.yaml points strictly to system temp. check_readonly_scope() returns ISOLATED_COPY_VERIFIED. Zero symlinks/junctions.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Embedding server provenance and authorization boundary
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: llama-server PID 2404 started 23:05:33 by Gemini agent via background task following operator instruction 'Восстанови llama server после перезагрузки' (step 8).

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Model index identity vs dimensionality and cosine similarity
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: index_manifest.json specifies Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-GGUF, dim 1024. GGUF SHA256: 06507c7b... High cosine (0.8756) confirms sanity, but cryptographic identity remains UNVERIFIED until reference vector test.
Q088 canonically categorized as SYNTHETIC_ADVERSARIAL in tests/pilot_query_manifest_105.json. Ambiguous revisions goal documented alongside canonical category.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Gold answers verification against primary normative sources
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: Q004 (clause 6.4) text is air intake devices, not duct limits. Q010 (clause 6.10) spans multiple chunks and is truncated. Gold answers remain UNVERIFIED.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Raw file SHA256 vs internal canonical manifest_sha256
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: Raw file SHA256 is physical file hash (0a86d901...). Canonical manifest_sha256 is internal schema hash (6121e68c...). Distinction clarified.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Shadow EIG rank and payload invariance
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: In all 6 calls executed, rank and normalized payload between OFF and ON were 100% identical (rank_and_payload_identical: True). Divergence is treated as regression STOP.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Explicit operator approval requirement for Actions A/B/C
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: Approval for A, B, C was given explicitly in chat and formalized in TZ-011 Rev 1.1 at 23:36. TZ-012 reflects earlier pre-approval state (23:31).

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Boot recovery status after LogonTrigger configuration
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: Task Scheduler XML updated with LogonTrigger (30s) and 5m poll. Physical reboot not yet observed.

p6_evidence_matrix.criterion: Watcher queue and idempotency under watcher.pause
p6_evidence_matrix.evidence: Watcher discovers new TXT and enqueues job by file SHA256 without dispatching session (dispatch=0) while watcher.pause is present. No duplicate jobs created.
